verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is Unity's own marketing line that it builds both 2D and 3D games. That is a first-party claim of 2D support, but none of the story's specifics are documented. Much of the remaining messaging is 3D-centric, so whether 2D is first-class rather than secondary is unproven. Missing for 10: documented sprite workflow, tilemap tooling, 2D physics system, any evidence that 2D is first-class rather than an add-on, independent or hands-on corroboration.
